Dear Madam,
I have read the papers you enclosed with much interest but I am afraid that I can hardly make them available at the present time.[^1] They are written so much in the style of the former generation that they would hardly suit this one, excepting the Rivers, and that is too much of a fragment.

With many thanks therefore I return them

yours faithfully

C M Yonge

[^1]: CMY judges them unsuitable for [MP.](../others.html#52)
